items.name: Italian Dip
items.desc: Savor the rich flavors of our Italian Dip Sandwich, featuring a blend of Italian pork and beef sausage, sautéed onions, roasted garlic, and mushrooms, all topped with melted Swiss cheese. Served with a side of au jus gravy for dipping, this sandwich is a hearty and flavorful treat that’s perfect for dipping and enjoying.

items.name: Meatball Sub
items.desc: Sink your teeth into this hearty classic featuring our tender, flavorful meatballs simmered in our vodka cream tomato sauce. Topped with melted parmasean and served on a toasted sub roll, it’s a comforting and satisfying favorite that hits all the right notes.

items.name: Ham & Burrata
items.desc: Indulge in a delightful blend of flavors with our Ham & Burrata Sandwich. This sandwich features savory ham paired with creamy burrata topped with olive oil & black pepper, a drizzle of sweet honey, & freshly tossed arugula salad, all served on our freshly baked focaccia. It's a perfect mix of sweet, savory, and creamy in every bite.

items.name: Italian Cold Cut
items.desc: Enjoy a classic Italian cold cut sandwich stacked with capicola, salami, pepperoni, ham, and provolone all served on our freshly baked focaccia. This flavorful combination is topped with mayo, crisp lettuce dressed in oil and vinegar, ripe tomato, fresh onion, and tangy pepperoncini, making each bite a perfect balance of savory and zesty flavors.

items.name: Salami & Stuffed Pepperoncini
items.desc: Enjoy the bold flavors of savory salami paired with cream cheese stuffed pepperoncini, fresh arugula, & ripe tomato, all balanced with a touch of creamy mayo. Layered on our freshly baked focaccia, this sandwich delivers a satisfying blend of tangy, creamy, and fresh ingredients in every bite.
